mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to hire a dog owner liability lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most dog owner liability lawyers work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront fees or hourly charges. Instead, the lawyer's fee is a percentage of the compensation they successfully recover for you. If they don't win your case, you typically owe no attorney's fees. This arrangement makes legal representation accessible to those who might not otherwise be able to afford it.
